titleEn: Divide an Array Into Subarrays With Minimum Cost II
title: 将数组分成最小总代价的子数组 II
summary: 把数组分成 k 个连续非空子数组，以各子数组首元素之和为代价，并要求第二与第 k 个子数组首下标之差不超过 dist；求最小总代价。
insight: 除 nums[0] 固定成为第一段代价外，还要选择 k-1 个递增下标作为其余段的起点，并且这些下标的最大值与最小值之差不超过 dist。因此问题等价于：在 nums[1..] 的每个长度 dist+1 的下标窗口中，求最小的 k-1 个值之和。滑动窗口内用两个有序多重集维护较小的 k-1 项及其总和即可。
pitfalls: 选择的是子数组首下标，对应值不要求在数值上有序
第二段到最后一段首下标的跨度包含两端，窗口长度是 dist+1
nums[0] 的代价固定且只在最后加一次
窗口内有重复值时必须按出现次数维护多重集
k-1 个较小值的和及最终答案可能超过 int，必须使用 long

solutions.title: 滑窗维护最小 k-1 项
solutions.idea: 用两个平衡树多重集动态维护每个合法下标窗口中的 k-1 个最小值。
steps: 把 nums[1..dist+1] 加入窗口结构
small 保存 need 个最小值并维护其和，large 保存其余值
记录 nums[0]+smallSum 作为当前答案
窗口右移时删除离开的值并加入新值
每次在两个集合间移动边界元素以恢复 small 大小和有序性
返回所有窗口中的最小总代价

code.java: class Solution { private static class Window { final int need;final TreeMap<Integer,Integer> small=new TreeMap<>(),large=new TreeMap<>();int smallSize=0;long sum=0;Window(int need){this.need=need;}void insert(TreeMap<Integer,Integer> map,int value){map.put(value,map.getOrDefault(value,0)+1);}void erase(TreeMap<Integer,Integer> map,int value){int count=map.get(value);if(count==1)map.remove(value);else map.put(value,count-1);}void add(int value){insert(small,value);smallSize++;sum+=value;if(smallSize>need){int moved=small.lastKey();erase(small,moved);smallSize--;sum-=moved;insert(large,moved);}}void remove(int value){if(small.containsKey(value)){erase(small,value);smallSize--;sum-=value;}else erase(large,value);if(smallSize<need&&!large.isEmpty()){int moved=large.firstKey();erase(large,moved);insert(small,moved);smallSize++;sum+=moved;}}}public long minimumCost(int[] nums,int k,int dist){Window window=new Window(k-1);for(int index=1;index<=dist+1;index++)window.add(nums[index]);long answer=nums[0]+window.sum;for(int right=dist+2;right<nums.length;right++){window.remove(nums[right-dist-1]);window.add(nums[right]);answer=Math.min(answer,nums[0]+window.sum);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private class Window(private val need:Int){private val small=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();private val large=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();private var smallSize=0;var sum=0L;private set;private fun insert(map:java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>,value:Int){map[value]=(map[value]?:0)+1};private fun erase(map:java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>,value:Int){val count=map[value]!!;if(count==1)map.remove(value)else map[value]=count-1}fun add(value:Int){insert(small,value);smallSize++;sum+=value;if(smallSize>need){val moved=small.lastKey();erase(small,moved);smallSize--;sum-=moved;insert(large,moved)}}fun remove(value:Int){if(small.containsKey(value)){erase(small,value);smallSize--;sum-=value}else erase(large,value);if(smallSize<need&&large.isNotEmpty()){val moved=large.firstKey();erase(large,moved);insert(small,moved);smallSize++;sum+=moved}}}fun minimumCost(nums:IntArray,k:Int,dist:Int):Long{val window=Window(k-1);for(index in 1..dist+1)window.add(nums[index]);var answer=nums[0]+window.sum;for(right in dist+2 until nums.size){window.remove(nums[right-dist-1]);window.add(nums[right]);answer=minOf(answer,nums[0]+window.sum)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Window{int need;multiset<int> small,large;long long sum=0;Window(int need):need(need){}void add(int value){small.insert(value);sum+=value;if((int)small.size()>need){auto it=prev(small.end());int moved=*it;sum-=moved;small.erase(it);large.insert(moved);}}void remove(int value){auto it=small.find(value);if(it!=small.end()){sum-=value;small.erase(it);}else large.erase(large.find(value));if((int)small.size()<need&&!large.empty()){auto first=large.begin();int moved=*first;large.erase(first);small.insert(moved);sum+=moved;}}};public:long long minimumCost(vector<int>& nums,int k,int dist){Window window(k-1);for(int index=1;index<=dist+1;++index)window.add(nums[index]);long long answer=nums[0]+window.sum;for(int right=dist+2;right<(int)nums.size();++right){window.remove(nums[right-dist-1]);window.add(nums[right]);answer=min(answer,nums[0]+window.sum);}return answer;} };
